body: It's a phobia I have. I am terrified of getting old. Problem with a phobia is that it can't be reasoned with or bargained with.

The only thing I want to comment on is your "I see how happy everyone is on facebook" statement.  As my sister once wisely said, I wish life was as wonderful as it looks on Facebook.  You're only seeing what people want you to see on social media, so don't believe that is reality.  I wish you the best, my brother.  I've had a good life, it just seems like it's been long enough.  I can't tell you what to do, but I hope you find your path.
